summary: TRACK 19.02 Transportation Operations Operational Readiness Hardening — VERIFIED GREEN end-to-end. Backend pytest 302/302 PASS, 2 skipped, 0 failures across the full transportation regression suite (test_track_16_04_*, _16_06_*, _16_08_*, _18_12b_*, _18_12c_*, _19_00_*, _19_01_*, _19_02_* — exceeds the ~244-test mandate). All 11 new Track 19.02 tests pass. Live API contract confirmed: GET /api/admin/transportation/fleet/equipment returns 161 items (149 equipment_master MASCI transport-capable + 12 transport_trucks leased_carrier) with full summary {masci_fleet_total:149, masci_fleet_adopted:0, leased_total:12, categories:[9 categories]}; q/category/ownership/status filters work; dispatch+admin can read; anon → 401/403. Adopt endpoint is admin-only, idempotent (already_adopted=true on 2nd call), and rejects non-transport-capable categories (422). Orientation dashboard returns in ~0.4s with drivers_total=176, modules_active=11, certificates_total=49 (N+1 fix holding). /api/version returns commit='c95b0d90c88e' and built_at='2026-06-29T13:52:43Z' — no more 'unknown'. Frontend /transportation-operations/trucks renders as 'Fleet' with all 4 summary cards (tx-fleet-summary-masci/adopted/leased/total), 161 rows, category+ownership selects (tx-fleet-filter-category/ownership), 149 'Adopt into Transportation' CTAs, per-row testids tx-fleet-adopt-{eqid}. /transportation-operations/carriers shows summary chip strip tx-carriers-summary with 200 total, 161 active, 39 pending review (amber). TxOps sidebar has 26 unique entries with zero duplicates. Drivers list shows refresh + add_leased + link_cdl CTAs with 176 driver rows. Academy regression intact (11 published-or-in-development modules).

issues: tx-carriers-summary-holds chip is conditionally rendered (only shows when safety_hold>0). Live preview has 0 holds so the chip is absent. Acceptable per spec; flagging as observation only.

critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar nav inventory shows: overview, dispatch, live-operations, fleet, drivers, carriers, compliance, orientation, academy, intelligence, automation, cleanup, reports, administration (14 leaf items + 6 group labels + 6 group anchors = 26 testids total, all unique). Spec mentions 'Email Pilot' and 'Search' which I did not see as discrete sidebar entries — Search is the topbar global '⌘K' input and Email Pilot may be nested under Administration. Non-blocking, but consider promoting Email Pilot to a discoverable sidebar entry under Operations Intelligence or Administration if it is intended to be reachable from the sidebar.
Academy module card list renders 22 elements matching [data-testid^="academy-card-"] (11 module testids + 11 status testids) — already documented in Track 19.01 cert. No regression.
Carrier summary holds chip only renders when count > 0. Consider always rendering the chip (with 0) for layout stability; minor UX polish only.

Permission gate test for dispatch-only access to /admin/transportation/intelligence was covered by pytest (test_fleet_adopt_is_admin_only PASS); did not re-verify in UI because the live super-admin token carries both admin and dispatch portals.
